source_claims.statement: Recon with concurrent requests found OpenAPI and URL-accepting endpoints. Confirmed SSRF via interactsh on /cog/info.

Used GDAL VFS and VRT files. Multiple approaches failed (missing imageAttributes, some VFS modules, histogram impractical). Breakthrough with raw pixel data then byte-by-byte via ImageOffset + /cog/statistics. Final pivot to local file paths.

research_questions.formulation: Given a confirmed SSRF into a GDAL-based tile renderer, can VRT/VFS features be used to turn the image output into a file-reading oracle?
research_questions.anchor: transition from SSRF confirmation to VRT experiments
research_questions.uncertainty_reduced: whether the renderer’s legitimate features can be composed into an LFI
research_questions.assumption_challenged: that SSRF to a tile service is limited to remote fetches

environment_model_updates: VRT XML can reference remote or local paths
/cog/preview.png and /cog/statistics can be used as oracles for pixel/histogram data

systematic_vs_exploratory.systematic: API path enumeration, SSRF confirmation with OOB
systematic_vs_exploratory.exploratory: VFS/VRT experiments, multiple failed extraction methods, refinement to byte-by-byte

negative_inconclusive: Direct flag access failed due to missing XML attributes
Some VFS modules and endpoints initially failed
Histogram approach revealed content but was impractical
unobserved_history: full list of failed VFS modules
forbidden_inferences: Do not treat early extraction failures as evidence the SSRF was useless
Composition of VRT + statistics is a discovered capability, not an a-priori plan
next_evidence_actions: Note the related TiTiler RCE in SRC-000012 for lineage grouping
layer_b_candidate_principles: A confirmed SSRF into a media or geospatial processor may be composable with the processor’s own referencing features (VRT, VFS) into a higher-impact oracle
Partial oracles (histogram, raw pixels) can be refined into precise extraction methods rather than abandoned
model_vs_harness: Recognizing that VRT/VFS can be turned into an oracle is model reasoning; systematic OOB confirmation and logging of failed extraction attempts can be harness.
